title_en: Supreme People's Court Releases Five Typical Cases of Infringement of Intellectual Property Rights and Manufacturing and Selling Counterfeit and Shoddy Goods
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Releases Five Typical Cases of Intellectual Property Infringement and Production and Sale of Counterfeit and Shoddy Goods

To support the nationwide special campaign against intellectual property infringement and the production and sale of counterfeit and shoddy goods, to deter lawbreakers, to effectively protect intellectual property rights, and to maintain the order of the socialist market economy, the Supreme People's Court has released the third batch of five typical cases of intellectual property infringement and production and sale of counterfeit and shoddy goods:

I. Defendant Shen Donglan et al. — Production and Sale of Counterfeit Drugs Case

The Intermediate People's Court of Nantong City, Jiangsu Province, found after trial: From March to December 2007, the defendant Shen Donglan purchased counterfeit "Human Albumin" produced by Shanghai RAAS Blood Products Co., Ltd. and counterfeit "Human Rabies Vaccine" produced by Fu'er Bio-Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd., together with counterfeit "Human Rabies Vaccine" produced by Fu'er Bio-Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. which she manufactured jointly with her son-in-law Liu Lei, and sold them to the defendant Zhao Yuxia. The total sales amount was RMB 17,665. Knowing that the purchased "Human Albumin" and "Human Rabies Vaccine" were counterfeit drugs, Zhao Yuxia sold them to the defendants Gao Biao and Hao Chuanzhi (separately prosecuted), with a total sales amount of RMB 25,860. Gao Biao then sold the counterfeit drugs to the defendants She Yonghong, Shen Jianbo (separately prosecuted), Liu Wei (separately prosecuted), and Xiao Zhenglan, with a total sales amount of RMB 145,900. Shen Jianbo sold the purchased counterfeit drugs to Ye Baojin (separately prosecuted) and others. The victim Zhao Yuying was bitten by a dog and was injected with the counterfeit "Human Rabies Vaccine" by Ye Baojin, subsequently died from a rabies attack. She Yonghong sold the purchased counterfeit drugs to Li Xiangyang and others, resulting in the counterfeit drugs being sold layer by layer to end users. After multiple patients were injected with the counterfeit "Human Albumin", they exhibited varying degrees of adverse reactions. Among them, five were identified as seriously injured and one as slightly injured.

The Nantong Intermediate People's Court, in accordance with the law, sentenced the defendant Shen Donglan to death, with a two-year reprieve, deprivation of political rights for life, and confiscation of all personal property for the crime of producing and selling counterfeit drugs; sentenced the defendant Zhao Yuxia to life imprisonment, deprivation of political rights for life, and confiscation of all personal property for the crime of selling counterfeit drugs; sentenced the defendant Gao Biao to fifteen years' imprisonment, deprivation of political rights for three years, and a fine of RMB 200,000 for the crime of selling counterfeit drugs; sentenced the defendant She Yonghong to fourteen years' imprisonment, deprivation of political rights for two years, and a fine of RMB 150,000 for the crime of selling counterfeit drugs; and confiscated the illegal gains of each defendant. After the judgment was pronounced, the defendant Zhao Yuxia appealed. After trial, the Jiangsu High People's Court rejected Zhao Yuxia's appeal and upheld the original judgment.

II. Defendants Liu Zhifeng, Liu Lei et al. — Production and Sale of Counterfeit and Substandard Products Case

The Intermediate People's Court of Chengdu City, Sichuan Province, found after trial: From October 2009 to March 2010, for the purpose of seeking profits, the defendants Liu Zhifeng and Liu Lei successively organized the defendants Liu Bo and Liu Yueguang to produce a product named "Dafeng Sesame Oil" by adding flavoring to corn oil, and sold it as sesame oil. By the time the case was discovered, Liu Zhifeng and Liu Lei had jointly participated in the production and sale of 87,992.17 kg of counterfeit sesame oil, with a total sales amount of RMB 1,437,953.4; Liu Bo participated in the production and sale of 45,117.73 kg of counterfeit sesame oil, with a total sales amount of RMB 722,844.6; Liu Yueguang participated in the production and sale of 4,950 kg of counterfeit sesame oil, with a sales amount of RMB 80,340.

The Chengdu Intermediate People's Court held that all four defendants constituted the crime of producing and selling counterfeit and substandard products. Liu Zhifeng and Liu Lei were principals, while Liu Bo and Liu Yueguang were accessories and did not participate in the distribution of sales profits; Liu Bo surrendered himself, so his punishment could be mitigated, and Liu Yueguang's punishment could be lenient. The Chengdu Intermediate People's Court sentenced the defendant Liu Zhifeng to twelve years' imprisonment and a fine of RMB 1,000,000; sentenced the defendant Liu Lei to twelve years' imprisonment and a fine of RMB 1,000,000; sentenced the defendant Liu Bo to three years' imprisonment and a fine of RMB 500,000; and sentenced the defendant Liu Yueguang to one year's imprisonment and a fine of RMB 50,000. After the judgment was pronounced, the four defendants appealed. After trial, the Sichuan High People's Court rejected the appeals and upheld the original judgment.

III. Defendant Lu Guangsheng — Selling Goods Bearing Counterfeit Registered Trademarks Case

The Nangang District People's Court of Harbin City, Heilongjiang Province, found after review: In April 2010, the defendant Lu Guangsheng met the victim Ming Xingji, falsely claiming to be the general agent for Moutai Group in the three northeastern provinces. Ming Xingji then expressed to Lu Guangsheng his intention to purchase 10 cases of Moutai liquor. Lu Guangsheng purchased 10 cases (12 bottles per case) of counterfeit Feitian brand Moutai liquor at a price of RMB 2,200 per case and sold them to Ming Xingji at RMB 388 per bottle. Afterwards, the victim Li Zhongming, through Ming Xingji's introduction, purchased Moutai liquor from Lu Guangsheng. Lu Guangsheng sold 20 cases of counterfeit Moutai liquor to Li Zhongming at RMB 580 per bottle. The total sales amount from the two transactions was RMB 185,760, with an illegal profit of RMB 119,760.

The Nangang District People's Court held that the defendant Lu Guangsheng's conduct constituted the crime of selling goods bearing counterfeit registered trademarks. Considering his good attitude in admitting guilt and full restitution of illegal gains, a lenient punishment could be imposed. The court sentenced Lu Guangsheng to one year's imprisonment and a fine of RMB 40,000. After the first-instance judgment was pronounced, the defendant Lu Guangsheng did not appeal, and the judgment has taken legal effect.

IV. Defendants Li Yuanmin and Sun Yanfeng — Production and Sale of Counterfeit and Substandard Products Case

The Fengxian People's Court of Jiangsu Province found after trial: In 2007, the defendant Li Yuanmin registered and established Xuzhou Kekewang Fertilizer Co., Ltd. Without a production license, he produced substandard "Kekewang" series fertilizers, with a total sales amount of over RMB 490,000. The defendant Sun Yanfeng, knowing that the "Kekewang" series fertilizers were substandard products, still sold 31 tons of fertilizers, with a total sales amount of over RMB 60,000.

The Fengxian People's Court held that the defendants Li Yuanmin and Sun Yanfeng violated national product quality regulations, intentionally passing off substandard products as qualified products in their production and sales activities. Their conduct constituted the crime of producing and selling counterfeit and substandard products and the crime of selling counterfeit and substandard products (the conduct did not cause significant losses to production, so it was not treated as the crime of producing and selling counterfeit fertilizers). Given that both defendants had the circumstance of voluntary surrender, their punishment could be lenient. The Fengxian People's Court sentenced Li Yuanmin to four years' imprisonment and a fine of RMB 250,000; and sentenced Sun Yanfeng to four months' criminal detention, suspended for eight months, and a fine of RMB 30,000. After the judgment was pronounced, the defendant Li Yuanmin appealed. After trial, the Xuzhou Intermediate People's Court rejected Li Yuanmin's appeal and upheld the original judgment.

V. Defendant Luo Zhongwei — Selling Counterfeit Fertilizers Case

The Huaxian People's Court of Henan Province found after trial: The defendant Luo Zhongwei, knowing that mineral element synergists needed to be used together with other fertilizers and could not be used alone as fertilizers, conspired with others to sell mineral element synergists as fertilizers. On July 26, 2008, Luo Zhongwei, in the name of the Nanyang Wancheng District Xinxin Natural Mineral Plant Products Factory, signed a fertilizer supply and marketing contract with Huaxian Shuntian Planting and Breeding Farmers' Professional Cooperative for 1,000 tons of fertilizer, with a unit price of RMB 1,350 per ton. During performance, 592 tons were actually supplied. After use by farmers, the wheat yield from 6,830 mu of land was reduced, causing direct economic losses of RMB 1,836,723.

The Huaxian People's Court sentenced the defendant Luo Zhongwei to twelve years' imprisonment and a fine of RMB 400,000 for the crime of selling counterfeit fertilizers. After the judgment was pronounced, Luo Zhongwei appealed. After trial, the Nanyang Intermediate People's Court rejected Luo Zhongwei's appeal and upheld the original judgment.
